description: This file defines locator generator functions and classes for different programming languages (JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, JSONL) used in the Playwright testing framework. It includes parsing, stringifying, and generating code snippets for locators based on selectors, with support for various locator types and options.

classes.name: JavaScriptLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator code snippets for JavaScript, supporting various locator types and options.

classes.name: PythonLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator code snippets for Python, supporting various locator types and options.

classes.name: JavaLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator code snippets for Java, supporting various locator types and options.

classes.name: CSharpLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator code snippets for C#, supporting various locator types and options.

classes.name: JsonlLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator definitions in JSONL format.

methods.name: innerAsLocators
methods.description: Converts parsed selectors into locator code snippets using a factory, handling nested and complex selectors.

methods.name: combineTokens
methods.description: Combines multiple locator tokens into chained locator strings, respecting max output size.

methods.name: detectExact
methods.description: Detects if a string indicates an exact match (e.g., regex or quoted string) and returns the processed text and exact flag.

methods.name: isRegExp
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a RegExp instance.
